# Leak-to-pointee precision applies to Go packages only under
# GOEXPERIMENT=logosescape, which is off by default.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
go build -gcflags=-m .
stderr 'p\.go:.*leaking param: q'
env GOEXPERIMENT=logosescape
go build -gcflags=-m .
stderr 'p\.go:.*q does not escape'
! stderr 'leaking param: q'
logos build -gcflags=-m .
stderr 'p\.go:.*q does not escape'
! stderr 'leaking param: q'

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/pointeego

go 1.27

-- m/p.go --
package p

type node struct {
	next *node
	v    int
}

//go:noinline
func linkThrough(p, q *node) {
	p.next = q
}
